sources.title: First bone-cracking dog coprolites provide new insight into bone consumption in Borophagus and their unique ecological niche

sources.evidence: Figure7 real B.secundus F:AM61640 side skull/mandible and upper/lower tooth rows with3cm bars inspected. Supports vaulted forehead, shortened rostrum, broad palate, deep jaws.
